stage: Composition proposal before revised Blender model
status: New common composition for two separate user-selected B/C directions; products and additions await fit verification. Sparse earlier wall studies superseded.
brief: Make the entire office feel designed: one anchored workspace, a lit storage console and a calm visitor corner.

zones.title: An anchored work area
zones.description: Two independent desk surfaces read as one workspace inside a dark wrap on the existing workwall and adjacent window wall. A gray felt/slate mat grounds the primary worktop. Keep its standing-height envelope clear. Over the fixed project bench, center a shallow black115cm ledge with small books/plant groups, then hang the exact Richmond landscape print above it. One owned Mineral Aeron serves both surfaces.

zones.title: A lit clothes-storage console
zones.description: The dark three-drawer chest becomes an intentional console: one opal-glass decorative lamp and a modest tray. White opal/lightgray repeat the owned Honeywell/Aeron highlights; leave useful top space and tuck the task chair for drawer access.

zones.title: A calm visitor corner
zones.description: The gray-blue bouclé chair and quiet graphic Rift rug tie the cool walls together. A modest palm gives the brick-side corner a vertical green layer only if its actual foliage clears the chair, closet and door routes. The brown wicker cat tree is retained as a natural counterpoint.

B.name: Charcoal + Slat Bay
B.wall: PeppercornSW7674 #585858 wraps workwall and adjacent windowwall. FIVE60cm BlackAsh/BlackFelt panels form a bounded3m-wide×2.4m-high bay across BOTHdesk sections. Keep white ceiling/trim and existing brick.

C.name: Ink Studio
C.wall: NavalSW6244 #2F3D4C wraps the same two existing walls. Smooth matte paint; no copied Pin grooves or extra shelves. The shared ledge/art, console and lounge composition creates the depth.

retained_architecture: Window, radiator, pipe and built-in shelf nook
retained_products: Owned brown MUTTROS threebasket cat tree
